about: Checks grade_scripted.py runs for skills/compositor/evals/evals.json. Each entry grades the one expectation whose text contains 'match'; the rest are left for the grader agent. Paths are relative to the run's outputs/ (the Agent folder); baselines to the replayed fixtures.

1.match: exports/promo-draft-half.png exists in the Agent folder and is 540 x 540
promo-draft-v2.comp exists in the Agent folder
the Badge layer's transform origin x is 40 greater and y is 20 smaller
get_document (or get_layer) before the first edit
No tool call passes overwrite: true or discard_changes: true

2.match: the Logo layer inside the Footer folder has a transform origin y 24 smaller
The top-level Logo layer's transform is identical in both files
The Footer folder's locks in promo-draft-footer.comp include position
never by the bare name Logo
promo-draft.comp/manifest.json has the same sha256 as before the run

3.match: The pre-existing exports/promo-draft.png has the same sha256
A render tool is called after the band is added and before the export
